summary: Fixed a 210 px bottom RenderFlex overflow in the empty text-channel welcome state at a 320 dp Android viewport. The text content can now grow beyond its minimum visual height and remain vertically scrollable.

checks.name: Android mixed channel navigation and long names at 320×640
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/widget_test.dart --plain-name 'Android mixed channel drawer fits long names at 320 dp'
checks.observation: A real text and voice channel are present in the mobile drawer. Both long navigation labels use ellipsis; the long text-channel welcome remains available by scrolling; no RenderFlex overflow or other layout exception is reported. This test failed before the fix with an overflow of 210 px.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite and static analysis
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test && flutter analyze
checks.observation: 223 widget/unit tests passed; flutter analyze reported no issues.

checks.name: Android release APK build and signature

checks.observation: The APK was rebuilt from source revision 8bd3c7f, APK Signature Scheme v2 verification passed, and the existing tracked release artifact was replaced at the same path.
